headline: The paper's recidivism headline has not been re-estimated on post-2007 or non-Washington data (no public data allows it); on the same Washington file under 2026 RD inference the 0.08 effect is bandwidth-dependent — RBC 95% CI [-0.031, -0.002] excludes zero, the honest CI [-0.031, 0.001] includes it — with the point estimate -0.017 stable vs the paper method's -0.0221.

notes: Launch scope: Study A (methods-and-transport) only; Part II theory-update not executed.
Branch N: openICPSR do-files not obtained, so the 0.15 coding is reported under both statutory (>=) and strict (>) definitions with equal standing.
The recidivism effect itself is NOT re-estimated on new data; no public person-linked recidivism data exists beyond Hansen's 1999-2007 Washington extract (pending records requests).
No Florida person linkage or recidivism outcome (out of scope / ethics-gated); all subject/officer names dropped in memory and never written to disk.
